text.p: Emirates Airline takes delivery of its sixth Boeing 777 later this month and its seventh in September, completing the order with Boeing Industries, the airline said in a statement.

The B777 will be introduced on the services from Dubai to Rome, Nice and Male in the Maldives, from August 1. Three of the airline's five weekly services to Male, will be operated by the B777, the remainging two will continue with Airbus aircraft. The aircraft will also provide 10 of the airline's 11 weekly flights to Singapore and from October 1 all services to Hong Kong and Manila.

Ray Disson, Cargo Manager UK & Ireland, said: "These additional flights will increase capacity where it is most needed to meet the demand for cargo space." The B777 provides double the cargo capacity of Emirates' current Airbus. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
